steps.say: For tenancies of two years or more, the agreement lets either side end the tenancy early. The tenant can give 3 months’ notice in writing to end it early.

The timeline shows the earliest dates counted from the start. As background, parties can also always agree together to surrender the tenancy. Any overpaid rent after an early ending must be repaid to the Tenant within 14 days if vacated.

For selling, the landlord gives a first intention notice after 2 months, then a break notice within 4 months with evidence it is marketed. The end date must be at least 2 months after the break notice and at least 4 months after the first notice. Record these as key dates which they need to remember.
